title: Personal Credit Cards: Paying Account for a Closing Automatic Payment
content:
A closing automatic payment on Personal Credit Cards must have somewhere to draw from. This page states which account qualifies and what follows when none does.

## Rule

A closing instruction can draw only on a checking account at PCB that the cardholder owns and that the bank's checking records show as active. A cardholder with no account of that kind cannot have a closing automatic payment recorded, and the fixed sum is then 0.00 USD.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- A cardholder with one active checking account and one closed checking account: the active account can carry the closing instruction.
- A cardholder whose only checking account is dormant: no closing instruction can be recorded; the sum is 0.00 USD.
- A cardholder with savings accounts but no active checking account: a savings account cannot carry it, so the sum is 0.00 USD.
